title: Steel Planker

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Changes processed logs into planks, increasing the price.

body:
"Can be used to turn processed logs, into a planked material!"

Description

The Steel Planker is a machine that can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $20,000. It converts sanded logs into planks; it is the woodworking counterpart to the Metal Forge, increasing the sell price of wood.

Note: the Statistic Tool falsely purports not, but the Steel Planker does increase the price of wood.

Appearance

The Steel Planker has a very similar look to metalworking machinery, sporting a control panel that can be used to modify the output size of planks. It shares the same coloring and material used on the Metal Forge.

Trivia

  • The default plank size is 2.5 by 2.5 studs
  • Prior to v1.52.0, it was named the Metal Planker
  • Prior to v1.52.0, its price was $19,200
  • If an object is blocking the output, it will not produce (same with forgers and plankers).
    • During blockage it will save entered materials (the amount of them is shown in stat info menu), after removing blockage it will produce all queued materials from first entered to last entered.
